description: Legislative advocacy pipeline for Missouri General Assembly outreach — CoTrackPro & Access To ecosystem

stages.label: Identified
stages.description: Legislator added to target list based on committee relevance, district, or leadership position
stages.entry_action: Add to pipeline with relevance score

stages.label: Researched
stages.description: Committee assignments, voting history, public statements, and staff contacts gathered

stages.label: Letter Sent
stages.description: First written contact — mailed letter, email, or both

stages.label: Packet Delivered
stages.description: In-person drop-off at Capitol office or district office
stages.entry_action: Deliver packet, log recipient name and timestamp

stages.label: Meeting Requested
stages.description: Follow-up call or email to schedule a meeting with legislator or staff
stages.entry_action: Call Capitol office, send calendar invite
stages.exit_criteria: Meeting scheduled or 3 follow-up attempts made

stages.label: Meeting Held
stages.entry_action: Present demo, discuss policy alignment, document commitments
stages.exit_criteria: Meeting notes documented, next steps identified

stages.label: Champion
stages.description: Legislator or staff expresses active interest or support
stages.entry_action: Provide additional materials, connect to advisory network
stages.exit_criteria: Legislator agrees to take specific action

stages.label: Sponsor
stages.description: Legislator agrees to sponsor legislation, pilot program, or appropriation request
stages.entry_action: Provide draft language, testimony support, fiscal impact data
stages.exit_criteria: Bill filed or appropriation request submitted

stages.label: Dormant
stages.description: No response after 3+ contact attempts across different channels
stages.exit_criteria: Re-engage on relevant bill introduction or interim session

legislator_name.description: Full name with title (e.g., 'Sen. Cindy O\'Laughlin')

leadership_role.description: e.g., 'President Pro Tem', 'Majority Floor Leader', 'Committee Chair'

priority_tier.description: Outreach priority based on scoring framework

capitol_office_room.description: Room number at 201 W. Capitol Ave., Jefferson City, MO 65101

district_office_address.description: Home district office address if available

staff_contact_name.description: Legislative aide or chief of staff name

next_action.description: Next step in the outreach sequence

campaign_tags.description: Which campaigns this outreach supports — e.g., ['cotrackpro', 'access-to-justice', 'access-to-safety']

total_touches.description: Total number of contact attempts across all channels

response_received.description: Whether any response has been received from the office

response_date.description: Date of first response from legislator or staff

days_to_response.description: Days between first contact and first response (auto-calculated)

meeting_outcome.description: Outcome of meeting if Stage 5+ reached

follow_up_count.description: Number of follow-up contacts after initial outreach

engagement_score.description: Composite engagement score: touches (20%) + response speed (20%) + sentiment (30%) + stage progression (30%)

contact_history.description: Chronological log of all contact attempts and responses

committees: Rules, Joint Rules, Resolutions and Ethics
example_rows.next_action: Research committee interests and recent bills
example_rows.notes: As President Pro Tem, controls committee appointments. High-value relationship.
